authoring: Original vector geometry, hierarchical groups, reusable assets, per-part pose overrides, per-shot keyframes; optional Python authoring SDK compiles to JSON.
coordinates: 960x540 design pixels; x right/y down; local transforms compose through groups; tracks use local shot frames; beats use global frames.
audio: Authored procedural bell/pop/purr cues; no voice synthesis or video model.
review: Brief coverage, visible drawing evidence, current preview, per-requirement observations and disclosed playback scope.
limitations: Vector 2D only; no full 3D/physics/automatic lip sync
Renderer does not infer story from text: the host LLM authors artwork, beats and keyframes
Declared visual reviews cannot automatically prove semantic correctness or comedy
No parity benchmark across other LLMs yet
Synchronous rendering; host Python code is not sandboxed by the kit
legacy: kit.scene/1.0 retained only for explicit regression/exercise use; prohibited in production workflows
